    AI Overview
    Deportivo Cuenca defeated Santos 1-0 on April 8, 2026, in the opening match of the Copa Sudamericana Group D. The decisive goal was a stunning goal direct from a corner kick (Gol Olímpico) around the 60th minute, resulting in an own goal by Santos goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão. 
    Match Details: 
    • Result: Deportivo Cuenca 1 - 0 Santos
    • Date: April 8, 2026
    • Venue: Alejandro Serrano Aguilar, Cuenca, Ecuador
    • Competition: Copa Sudamericana (Group Stage) 
    Key Moments & Notes: 
    • Winning Goal: The game's only goal occurred when a corner was quickly delivered, hitting the post and then goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão before going in.
    • Santos Absences: Santos played without superstar Neymar, who did not feature in the squad for the opener.
    • Impact: The win gives Deportivo Cuenca an early advantage in Group D, while Santos faces a difficult start away from home.

    Which country is Deportivo Cuenca in?
    Ecuadorian
    Club Deportivo Cuenca is an Ecuadorian football club based in Cuenca. They currently play in the Serie A, the top-flight football league in the country, and is one of two clubs from Cuenca to have played in the top-flight (the other being LDU Cuenca).
